multiplier_expense_approved_trigger.description: Runs each time an expense claim is approved in Multiplier. Ones approved before the workflow is turned on don't start it. It can watch up to 4,000. How often it checks follows your workspace plan.

multiplier_new_employee_trigger.description: Runs for each new employee in Multiplier. Ones already there when the workflow is turned on don't start it. It can watch up to 4,000. How often it checks follows your workspace plan.

multiplier_new_expense_trigger.description: Runs for each new expense claim in Multiplier. Ones already there when the workflow is turned on don't start it. It can watch up to 4,000. How often it checks follows your workspace plan.

multiplier_new_time_off_trigger.description: Runs for each new time off request in Multiplier. Ones already there when the workflow is turned on don't start it. It can watch up to 4,000. How often it checks follows your workspace plan.

multiplier_new_timesheet_trigger.description: Runs for each new timesheet in Multiplier. Ones already there when the workflow is turned on don't start it. It can watch up to 4,000. How often it checks follows your workspace plan.

multiplier_offboarding_stage_changed_tri.description: Runs each time an employee offboarding stage changes in Multiplier. Changes made before the workflow is turned on don't start it. It can watch up to 4,000. How often it checks follows your workspace plan.

multiplier_onboarding_stage_changed_trig.description: Runs each time an employee onboarding stage changes in Multiplier. Changes made before the workflow is turned on don't start it. It can watch up to 4,000. How often it checks follows your workspace plan.

multiplier_time_off_approved_trigger.description: Runs each time a time off is approved in Multiplier. Ones approved before the workflow is turned on don't start it. It can watch up to 4,000. How often it checks follows your workspace plan.

multiplier_timesheet_submitted_trigger.description: Runs each time a timesheet is submitted in Multiplier. Ones submitted before the workflow is turned on don't start it. It can watch up to 4,000. How often it checks follows your workspace plan.
